name: skill-ai-inject
description: Auto-match user delivery task with available skills for better agent responses

changes: fix: L2 debug logging — fixed conditional logic that always showed 'none' for scores below threshold
fix: keyword extraction now uses keyword.model instead of translate.model
fix: default llmModel changed from qwen3.5:4b to qwen2.5:3b
feat: L1 now uses fuzzy wordSimilarity scoring instead of hit ratio — description length no longer penalizes score
feat: L1 POS-weighted scoring — nouns/english get high weight (1.0), verbs/function words get low weight (0.01) via nodejieba tagger
feat: L1 English stopword filter — common English stopwords get low weight to reduce noise from generic query tokens
feat: L1 optional translation via keyword.translate config (default: false)
feat: keyword extraction limit increased from 5 to 30
feat: skill-meta.json now includes metaVersion field for automatic cache invalidation on extraction logic changes
fix: hook registration — use api.on (not registerHook) for standard before_prompt_build hook
fix: hook event field — use event.prompt instead of event.userMessage
fix: exported plugin id to skill-ai-inject to match package name
chore: rename project to skill-ai-inject
fix: README rewrite with complete documentation and OpenClaw configuration notes
refactor: reverse L1 keyword matching direction — extract from prompt first, then match skill.keywords
refactor: switch hook from before_agent_start to before_prompt_build (consistent with memory-recall)
fix: L1 score now uses hit ratio (hitCount/totalKeywords) instead of binary 1.0
fix: add l2CandidateCount config for embedding fallback pre-filter
chore: increase content hash from 16 to 24 chars
chore: warn log on meta write failure
chore: remove unused deliveryTaskPatterns config
chore: remove duplicate cosineSimilarity from utils
fix: correct import path to llm-connector (2 levels up, .ts extension)
L1 keyword match: zero-cost keyword trigger before embedding
LLM keyword extraction on skill load (3-5 trigger keywords per skill)
Skip translation when query already contains English characters
L1+L2 cascade: keyword match first, embed fallback
